title: circular-gh-ifc-ai: Grasshopper workflow for LLM-assisted IFC data enrichment
description: Supplementary material for Ploszaj-Mazurek, M., & Tofiluk, A. (2026). A workflow for LLM-assisted IFC data enrichment to support circular reuse of large-panel building systems in Poland. Journal of Building Engineering, 120, 115397. Contains the proof-of-concept Grasshopper definition and example BIM/IFC models: IFC parsing, data-completeness checking, two-stage attribute enrichment (deterministic lookup tables followed by LLM inference), element-level circularity scoring, colour-coded visualisation and CSV/JSON export. This is an experimental demonstrator, not a validated assessment tool. Code licensed MIT; example models and documentation licensed CC BY 4.0. Funded by Warsaw University of Technology under the Excellence Initiative: Research University (IDUB) programme.
